tools.name: get_influzer_overview
tools.description: Return a short overview of Influzer.ai: what it offers (MCP directory, WebMCP directory, insights) and key URLs agents should use.

tools.name: get_mcp_server
tools.description: Fetch one classic MCP server by slug from Influzer's directory: transport, indexed tools, install command, docs URL, and setup summary.

slug.description: Server slug from search_mcp_servers (e.g. playwright, postgres, firecrawl).

include_tools.description: Include tool name/description list. Defaults to true.

tools.name: get_webmcp_directory_stats
tools.description: Return live counts for the Influzer WebMCP Directory: sites, tools, live vs demo, categories, and last refresh time.

tools.name: get_webmcp_listing_scan
tools.description: Poll status of a WebMCP listing scan started by start_webmcp_listing_scan. Returns progress, detected tools, scorecard, and directory URL when published.

tools.name: get_webmcp_site
tools.description: Fetch one WebMCP-enabled website by host (e.g. persona-chat.dev), including description, tool list, and schemas when available.

include_schemas.description: When true, include full input schemas for each tool. Defaults to false for a shorter payload.

tools.name: list_latest_insights
tools.description: List the latest Influzer.ai insights / articles (titles, URLs, summaries) for agent briefings.

tools.name: navigate_influzer
tools.description: Navigate this browser tab to a first-party Influzer.ai path (e.g. /webmcp, /mcp, /webmcp/demo, /insights). Use after the user confirms they want to move.

path.description: Site path starting with /. Only same-origin Influzer paths are allowed.

tools.name: open_webmcp_site
tools.description: Navigate this browser tab to a WebMCP-enabled website's homepage so the user and agent can use that site's own document.modelContext tools together. Call only after the user confirms which host to open.

host.description: Hostname from search_webmcp_sites or recommend_agent_stack (no protocol).

path.description: Optional path on that host (must start with /). Defaults to /.

tools.name: recommend_agent_stack
tools.description: Given an app or workflow goal, search BOTH Influzer directories at once: WebMCP websites (in-browser page tools) and classic MCP servers (backend integrations). Returns a combined shortlist with tool previews and suggested next steps for building in ChatGPT or Cursor.

goal.description: What you are building, e.g. 'e-commerce app with cart and Postgres' or 'coding agent with GitHub and docs lookup'.

limit.description: Max matches per surface (WebMCP sites, WebMCP tools, MCP servers). Defaults to 5.

include_tool_details.description: When true, include top tool names for each WebMCP site. Defaults to false.

tools.name: search_mcp_servers
tools.description: Search Influzer's MCP server directory (backend MCP integrations, not WebMCP). Returns matching servers with categories and tool names.

q.description: Free-text query matching server name, slug, description, or category.

scope.description: Search Top 100 (default) or the full catalog.

tools.name: search_webmcp_sites
tools.description: Search websites in the Influzer WebMCP Directory by keyword, category, site type, or verification status. Returns matching hosts with tool counts.

q.description: Free-text query matching host, name, description, or category.

type.description: Filter by site type. Defaults to all.

verified.description: Filter by verification status. Defaults to any.

limit.description: Max results to return (1–25). Defaults to 10.

tools.name: search_webmcp_tools
tools.description: Search WebMCP tools across all catalogued websites by tool name, description, or kind (answer / act / transact).

q.description: Free-text query matching tool name or description.

kind.description: Filter by tool kind. Defaults to any.

host.description: Optional host to limit tools to one site.

tools.name: start_webmcp_listing_scan
tools.description: Start an Influzer scan to detect WebMCP tools on a public website and queue it for directory listing. Requires the user's email, site URL, and explicit consent (user_confirmed: true). Returns a scan_id to poll with get_webmcp_listing_scan. Listing is scan-gated — sites with detected tools may be published after review.

url.description: Public website URL to scan (https://example.com or example.com).

email.description: Submitter email for the scan report and listing follow-up.

user_confirmed.description: Must be true — confirms the user explicitly asked to submit this URL and share their email.

relationship.description: Submitter relationship to the site. Defaults to owner.

newsletter.description: Subscribe email to Influzer newsletter for directory updates. Defaults to true.
